title: Amazon EventBridge to redrive AWS Step Functions failed state
description: Create an EventBridge rule to redrive a Step Fucntions workflow from a failed state

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Proactively detect workflow failures and initiate a Step Functions redrive, this elminiates the need to restart a workflow from the begnining.

bullets.text: Introducing AWS Step Functions redrive: a new way to restart workflows

testing.headline: Testing
text: Use the AWS CLI to send a test event to EventBridge and observe the event delivered to the Lambda function:
1. Send an event to EventBridge: aws events put-events --entries file://event.json.
2. Retrieve the logs from the Lambda function: sam logs -n ENTER_YOUR_CONSUMER_FUNCTION_NAME.

cleanup.headline: Cleanup
text: 2. Confirm the stack has been deleted: aws cloudformation list-stacks --query "StackSummaries[?contains(StackName,'STACK_NAME')].StackStatus"
